app_store.name: Mileprint: Run Story Maker
app_store.subtitle: No account. Just your run.
app_store.promotional_text: Your run is ready when you stop: new workouts sync in the background from Apple Health. Pick a sticker, add a photo, post. No account, no watermark.
app_store.description:
Turn every run into a story worth posting. No account, no feed, no waitlist.

Mileprint reads your workouts and gives you a canvas: drop your distance, pace, route and splits onto a photo, pick a font and colour, and share it to Instagram Stories in seconds. Everything stays on your phone.

YOUR RUN IS READY WHEN YOU STOP
- Syncs from Apple Health, including Apple Watch and any watch app that saves to Health
- Connects to Strava (Compatible with Strava)
- Opens GPX, TCX and FIT files from any watch or app
- New workouts arrive in the background, and the list shows when it last updated
- The same run from two places shows up once

MAKE IT LOOK LIKE YOU
- 26 sticker designs: big distance, pace, route, splits, watch laps, stat grids, week and month totals
- Five type styles and a palette of colours
- Drag, pinch and twist anything; add your own words
- Your photo, a colour or a gradient behind it
- Exports at full story size: what you see is what you post

SHARE IT YOUR WAY
- Straight to Instagram Stories
- Save to Photos or use the share sheet
- Copy a single sticker and paste it onto any photo or video

YOURS, NOT OURS
- No account and no sign-up
- No watermark on anything you make
- Your runs stay on your phone. Disconnect Strava and its activities are removed.
- Route ends are trimmed so your story never shows where you live

Runs, rides, walks, hikes, swims, skates, ski days, rows and climbs.

Questions or ideas? Settings > Help and feedback.
